<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

enum GameState: string
{
    case Ready = "ready";
    case Playing = "playing";
    case Won = "won";
    case Lost = "lost";
}
enum Mark: string
{
    case None = "none";
    case Flag = "flag";
    case Question = "question";
}
enum Safety: string
{
    case Block = "block";
    case Cell = "cell";
    case None = "none";
}
enum MoveKind: string
{
    case Reveal = "reveal";
    case Flag = "flag";
    case Unflag = "unflag";
    case Question = "question";
    case Chord = "chord";
    case AutoReveal = "auto-reveal";
    case AutoFlag = "auto-flag";
    case Guess = "guess";
}
final readonly class Move
{
    public function __construct(public MoveKind $kind, public int $cell) {}
}
final readonly class UndoRecord
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $name,
        public array $revealed,
        public array $marks,
        public int $moveCount,
    ) {}
}
final readonly class Constraint
{
    public function __construct(public int $cell, public array $unknown, public int $remaining) {}
}
final class CommandError extends RuntimeException {}
function fail(string $message): never
{
    throw new CommandError($message);
}
function emit(string|int ...$parts): void
{
    echo implode(" ", $parts), "\n";
}
function inputLine(): string
{
    return rtrim(fgets(STDIN), "\r\n");
}
function fraction(int $numerator, int $denominator): string
{
    $a = $numerator;
    $b = $denominator;
    while ($b !== 0) {
        [$a, $b] = [$b, $a % $b];
    }
    return intdiv($numerator, $a) . "/" . intdiv($denominator, $a);
}

final class Deduction
{
    public array $safe;
    public array $mines;
    public function __construct(int $size)
    {
        $this->safe = $this->mines = array_fill(0, $size, null);
    }
    public function any(): bool
    {
        foreach ($this->safe as $reason) {
            if ($reason !== null) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        foreach ($this->mines as $reason) {
            if ($reason !== null) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

final class Totals
{
    public int $rounds = 0,
        $flagged = 0,
        $opened = 0,
        $guesses = 0;
    public function add(self $other): void
    {
        $this->rounds += $other->rounds;
        $this->flagged += $other->flagged;
        $this->opened += $other->opened;
    }
}

final class Component
{
    public int $configurations = 0,
        $maximum = 0,
        $minimum;
    public array $mineCounts;
    private bool $counted = false;
    private array $index = [],
        $links = [],
        $order = [],
        $remaining = [],
        $sums = [],
        $assignment = [];

    public function __construct(public readonly array $cells, private readonly array $constraints)
    {
        $this->minimum = count($cells);
        $this->mineCounts = array_fill(0, count($cells), 0);
    }
    public function count(): void
    {
        if ($this->counted) {
            return;
        }
        $this->counted = true;
        foreach ($this->constraints as $constraint) {
            if (
                $constraint->remaining < 0 ||
                $constraint->remaining > count($constraint->unknown)
            ) {
                return;
            }
        }
        $this->index = array_flip($this->cells);
        $this->links = array_fill(0, count($this->cells), []);
        foreach ($this->constraints as $c => $constraint) {
            foreach ($constraint->unknown as $cell) {
                $this->links[$this->index[$cell]][] = $c;
            };
        }
        $this->order = array_keys($this->cells);
        usort(
            $this->order,
            fn(int $a, int $b): int => count($this->links[$b]) <=> count($this->links[$a]) ?:
            $a <=> $b,
        );
        $this->remaining = array_map(
            fn(Constraint $c): int => count($c->unknown),
            $this->constraints,
        );
        $this->sums = array_fill(0, count($this->constraints), 0);
        $this->assignment = array_fill(0, count($this->cells), 0);
        $this->search(0, 0);
    }
    private function search(int $depth, int $mines): void
    {
        if ($depth === count($this->cells)) {
            $this->configurations++;
            $this->minimum = min($this->minimum, $mines);
            $this->maximum = max($this->maximum, $mines);
            foreach ($this->assignment as $i => $value) {
                $this->mineCounts[$i] += $value;
            }
            return;
        }
        $variable = $this->order[$depth];
        for ($value = 0; $value <= 1; $value++) {
            $this->assignment[$variable] = $value;
            $possible = true;
            foreach ($this->links[$variable] as $c) {
                $this->remaining[$c]--;
                $this->sums[$c] += $value;
                $required = $this->constraints[$c]->remaining;
                if (
                    $this->sums[$c] > $required ||
                    $this->sums[$c] + $this->remaining[$c] < $required
                ) {
                    $possible = false;
                }
            }
            if ($possible) {
                $this->search($depth + 1, $mines + $value);
            }
            foreach ($this->links[$variable] as $c) {
                $this->sums[$c] -= $value;
                $this->remaining[$c]++;
            }
        }
    }
    public function mineCount(int $cell): int
    {
        return $this->mineCounts[$this->index[$cell]];
    }
}

final readonly class Frontier
{
    public function __construct(public array $components, public array $at) {}
}

final class Game
{
    public readonly int $size;
    public ?array $mines = null;
    public array $numbers,
        $neighbors = [],
        $revealed,
        $marks,
        $moves = [],
        $undo = [];
    public GameState $state = GameState::Ready;
    public ?int $exploded = null;

    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $width,
        public readonly int $height,
        public readonly int $mineCount,
        public readonly int $seed,
        ?array $placement = null,
    ) {
        $this->size = $width * $height;
        $this->revealed = array_fill(0, $this->size, false);
        $this->marks = array_fill(0, $this->size, Mark::None);
        $this->numbers = array_fill(0, $this->size, 0);
        for ($cell = 0; $cell < $this->size; $cell++) {
            $nearby = [];
            $x = $cell % $width;
            $y = intdiv($cell, $width);
            for ($dy = -1; $dy <= 1; $dy++) {
                for ($dx = -1; $dx <= 1; $dx++) {
                    if (
                        ($dx !== 0 || $dy !== 0) &&
                        $x + $dx >= 0 &&
                        $x + $dx < $width &&
                        $y + $dy >= 0 &&
                        $y + $dy < $height
                    ) {
                        $nearby[] = ($y + $dy) * $width + $x + $dx;
                    }
                };
            }
            $this->neighbors[] = $nearby;
        }
        if ($placement !== null) {
            $this->setPlacement($placement);
        }
    }
    public function finished(): bool
    {
        return $this->state === GameState::Won || $this->state === GameState::Lost;
    }
    public function remaining(): int
    {
        return $this->mineCount -
            count(array_filter($this->marks, fn(Mark $mark): bool => $mark === Mark::Flag));
    }
    public function openCount(): int
    {
        return count(array_filter($this->revealed));
    }
    public function cell(int $cell): string
    {
        return $cell % $this->width . "," . intdiv($cell, $this->width);
    }
    public function unknown(int $cell): bool
    {
        return !$this->revealed[$cell] && $this->marks[$cell] !== Mark::Flag;
    }
    public function flags(int $cell): int
    {
        return count(
            array_filter(
                $this->neighbors[$cell],
                fn(int $other): bool => $this->marks[$other] === Mark::Flag,
            ),
        );
    }
    public function unknownNeighbors(int $cell): array
    {
        return array_values(
            array_filter($this->neighbors[$cell], fn(int $other): bool => $this->unknown($other)),
        );
    }
    public function copy(bool $reset = false): self
    {
        $copy = clone $this;
        $copy->undo = [];
        if ($reset) {
            $copy->restart();
        }
        return $copy;
    }
    private function setPlacement(array $mines): void
    {
        $this->mines = $mines;
        foreach ($this->neighbors as $cell => $nearby) {
            $this->numbers[$cell] = count(
                array_filter($nearby, fn(int $other): bool => $mines[$other]),
            );
        }
        $this->state = GameState::Playing;
    }
    private function place(int $first, Safety $safety): void
    {
        $sx = $first % $this->width;
        $sy = intdiv($first, $this->width);
        $candidates = [];
        for ($cell = 0; $cell < $this->size; $cell++) {
            if (
                $safety === Safety::None ||
                ($safety === Safety::Cell && $cell !== $first) ||
                ($safety === Safety::Block &&
                    (abs(($cell % $this->width) - $sx) >= 2 ||
                        abs(intdiv($cell, $this->width) - $sy) >= 2))
            ) {
                $candidates[] = $cell;
            }
        }
        $mines = array_fill(0, $this->size, false);
        $random = $this->seed;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $this->mineCount; $i++) {
            $random = (48271 * $random) % 2147483647;
            $index = $random % count($candidates);
            $mines[$candidates[$index]] = true;
            array_splice($candidates, $index, 1);
        }
        $this->setPlacement($mines);
    }
    public function restart(): void
    {
        $this->revealed = array_fill(0, $this->size, false);
        $this->marks = array_fill(0, $this->size, Mark::None);
        $this->moves = $this->undo = [];
        $this->exploded = null;
        $this->state = $this->mines === null ? GameState::Ready : GameState::Playing;
    }
    public function snapshot(string $name): UndoRecord
    {
        return new UndoRecord($name, $this->revealed, $this->marks, count($this->moves));
    }
    public function restore(UndoRecord $saved): void
    {
        $this->revealed = $saved->revealed;
        $this->marks = $saved->marks;
        $this->moves = array_slice($this->moves, 0, $saved->moveCount);
    }
    public function reveal(int $first, Safety $safety): int
    {
        if ($this->mines === null) {
            $this->place($first, $safety);
        }
        if ($this->mines[$first]) {
            $this->state = GameState::Lost;
            $this->exploded = $first;
            return 0;
        }
        $queue = new SplQueue();
        $this->revealed[$first] = true;
        $this->marks[$first] = Mark::None;
        $queue->enqueue($first);
        $opened = 1;
        while (!$queue->isEmpty()) {
            $cell = $queue->dequeue();
            if ($this->numbers[$cell] === 0) {
                foreach ($this->neighbors[$cell] as $other) {
                    if ($this->unknown($other)) {
                        $this->revealed[$other] = true;
                        $this->marks[$other] = Mark::None;
                        $queue->enqueue($other);
                        $opened++;
                    }
                };
            }
        }
        return $opened;
    }
    public function chord(int $cell, Safety $safety): int
    {
        $opened = 0;
        foreach ($this->neighbors[$cell] as $other) {
            if ($this->unknown($other)) {
                $opened += $this->reveal($other, $safety);
                if ($this->state === GameState::Lost) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return $opened;
    }
    public function checkWin(): bool
    {
        if (
            $this->state !== GameState::Playing ||
            $this->openCount() !== $this->size - $this->mineCount
        ) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->state = GameState::Won;
        foreach ($this->mines as $cell => $mine) {
            if ($mine) {
                $this->marks[$cell] = Mark::Flag;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    public function display(): void
    {
        for ($y = 0; $y < $this->height; $y++) {
            $row = "";
            for ($x = 0; $x < $this->width; $x++) {
                $cell = $y * $this->width + $x;
                if ($this->state === GameState::Lost && $this->mines[$cell]) {
                    $row .=
                        $cell === $this->exploded
                            ? "!"
                            : ($this->marks[$cell] === Mark::Flag
                                ? "F"
                                : "*");
                } elseif ($this->state === GameState::Lost && $this->marks[$cell] === Mark::Flag) {
                    $row .= "X";
                } elseif ($this->revealed[$cell]) {
                    $row .= $this->numbers[$cell] === 0 ? "." : (string) $this->numbers[$cell];
                } else {
                    $row .= match ($this->marks[$cell]) {
                        Mark::Flag => "F",
                        Mark::Question => "?",
                        Mark::None => "#",
                    };
                }
            }
            emit($row);
        }
    }
    public function ending(): void
    {
        if ($this->state === GameState::Lost) {
            emit("boom", $this->cell($this->exploded));
            $this->display();
        } elseif ($this->state === GameState::Won) {
            emit("win moves", count($this->moves));
        }
    }
    private function constraints(): array
    {
        $constraints = [];
        for ($cell = 0; $cell < $this->size; $cell++) {
            if ($this->revealed[$cell] && $this->numbers[$cell] > 0) {
                $unknown = $this->unknownNeighbors($cell);
                if ($unknown !== []) {
                    $constraints[] = new Constraint(
                        $cell,
                        $unknown,
                        $this->numbers[$cell] - $this->flags($cell),
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        return $constraints;
    }
    public function deduce(): Deduction
    {
        $result = new Deduction($this->size);
        $constraints = $this->constraints();
        foreach ($constraints as $c) {
            if ($c->remaining === 0) {
                foreach ($c->unknown as $cell) {
                    $result->safe[$cell] ??= "single " . $this->cell($c->cell);
                };
            }
        }
        if ($result->any()) {
            return $result;
        }
        foreach ($constraints as $c) {
            if ($c->remaining === count($c->unknown)) {
                foreach ($c->unknown as $cell) {
                    $result->mines[$cell] ??= "single " . $this->cell($c->cell);
                };
            }
        }
        if ($result->any()) {
            return $result;
        }
        foreach ($constraints as $a) {
            foreach ($constraints as $b) {
                if (
                    count($a->unknown) >= count($b->unknown) ||
                    array_diff($a->unknown, $b->unknown) !== []
                ) {
                    continue;
                }
                $difference = array_diff($b->unknown, $a->unknown);
                $remaining = $b->remaining - $a->remaining;
                $reason = "subset " . $this->cell($a->cell) . " " . $this->cell($b->cell);
                if ($remaining === 0) {
                    foreach ($difference as $cell) {
                        $result->safe[$cell] ??= $reason;
                    };
                }
                if ($remaining === count($difference)) {
                    foreach ($difference as $cell) {
                        $result->mines[$cell] ??= $reason;
                    };
                }
            };
        }
        if ($result->any()) {
            return $result;
        }
        if ($this->state === GameState::Playing && $this->remaining() === 0) {
            for ($cell = 0; $cell < $this->size; $cell++) {
                if ($this->unknown($cell)) {
                    $result->safe[$cell] = "count";
                }
            };
        }
        return $result;
    }
    public function frontier(): Frontier
    {
        $constraints = $this->constraints();
        $links = array_fill(0, $this->size, []);
        foreach ($constraints as $i => $c) {
            foreach ($c->unknown as $cell) {
                $links[$cell][] = $i;
            };
        }
        $seen = array_fill(0, $this->size, false);
        $at = array_fill(0, $this->size, null);
        $components = [];
        for ($start = 0; $start < $this->size; $start++) {
            if ($seen[$start] || $links[$start] === []) {
                continue;
            }
            $cells = [$start];
            $selected = [];
            $picked = [];
            $seen[$start] = true;
            for ($head = 0; $head < count($cells); $head++) {
                foreach ($links[$cells[$head]] as $c) {
                    if (isset($picked[$c])) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $picked[$c] = true;
                    $selected[] = $constraints[$c];
                    foreach ($constraints[$c]->unknown as $cell) {
                        if (!$seen[$cell]) {
                            $seen[$cell] = true;
                            $cells[] = $cell;
                        }
                    }
                };
            }
            sort($cells, SORT_NUMERIC);
            $component = new Component($cells, $selected);
            $components[] = $component;
            foreach ($cells as $cell) {
                $at[$cell] = $component;
            }
        }
        return new Frontier($components, $at);
    }
    public function auto(Safety $safety): Totals
    {
        $total = new Totals();
        while ($this->state === GameState::Playing) {
            $deduction = $this->deduce();
            if (!$deduction->any()) {
                break;
            }
            $total->rounds++;
            foreach ($deduction->safe as $cell => $reason) {
                if ($reason !== null && !$this->revealed[$cell]) {
                    $this->moves[] = new Move(MoveKind::AutoReveal, $cell);
                    $total->opened += $this->reveal($cell, $safety);
                    $this->checkWin();
                    if ($this->finished()) {
                        return $total;
                    }
                }
            }
            foreach ($deduction->mines as $cell => $reason) {
                if ($reason !== null && $this->unknown($cell)) {
                    $this->marks[$cell] = Mark::Flag;
                    $total->flagged++;
                    $this->moves[] = new Move(MoveKind::AutoFlag, $cell);
                }
            }
        }
        return $total;
    }
    public function solve(Safety $safety): Totals
    {
        $total = new Totals();
        while (!$this->finished()) {
            $total->add($this->auto($safety));
            if ($this->finished()) {
                break;
            }
            $frontier = $this->frontier();
            foreach ($frontier->components as $component) {
                $component->count();
            }
            $unknownCount = 0;
            for ($cell = 0; $cell < $this->size; $cell++) {
                if ($this->unknown($cell)) {
                    $unknownCount++;
                }
            }
            $background = max($this->remaining(), 0);
            $best = null;
            $bestNumerator = 0;
            $bestDenominator = 1;
            for ($cell = 0; $cell < $this->size; $cell++) {
                if (!$this->unknown($cell)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $component = $frontier->at[$cell];
                if ($component !== null) {
                    if ($component->configurations === 0) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $numerator = $component->mineCount($cell);
                    $denominator = $component->configurations;
                } else {
                    $numerator = $background;
                    $denominator = $unknownCount;
                }
                if (
                    $best === null ||
                    $numerator * $bestDenominator < $bestNumerator * $denominator
                ) {
                    $best = $cell;
                    $bestNumerator = $numerator;
                    $bestDenominator = $denominator;
                }
            }
            if ($best === null) {
                break;
            }
            $total->guesses++;
            $this->moves[] = new Move(MoveKind::Guess, $best);
            $total->opened += $this->reveal($best, $safety);
            $this->checkWin();
        }
        return $total;
    }
    public function replay(int $count, Safety $safety): self
    {
        $copy = $this->copy(true);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
            $move = $this->moves[$i];
            $cell = $move->cell;
            switch ($move->kind) {
                case MoveKind::Reveal:
                case MoveKind::AutoReveal:
                case MoveKind::Guess:
                    $copy->reveal($cell, $safety);
                    break;
                case MoveKind::Chord:
                    $copy->chord($cell, $safety);
                    break;
                case MoveKind::Flag:
                case MoveKind::AutoFlag:
                    $copy->marks[$cell] = Mark::Flag;
                    break;
                case MoveKind::Unflag:
                    $copy->marks[$cell] = Mark::None;
                    break;
                case MoveKind::Question:
                    $copy->marks[$cell] =
                        $copy->marks[$cell] === Mark::Question ? Mark::None : Mark::Question;
                    break;
            }
            $copy->checkWin();
        }
        return $copy;
    }
    public function boardInfo(): void
    {
        $blank = [];
        for ($cell = 0; $cell < $this->size; $cell++) {
            $blank[] = !$this->mines[$cell] && $this->numbers[$cell] === 0;
        }
        $seen = array_fill(0, $this->size, false);
        $openings = 0;
        $largest = 0;
        $isolated = 0;
        for ($start = 0; $start < $this->size; $start++) {
            if ($blank[$start] && !$seen[$start]) {
                $openings++;
                $queue = [$start];
                $seen[$start] = true;
                $area = [$start => true];
                for ($head = 0; $head < count($queue); $head++) {
                    foreach ($this->neighbors[$queue[$head]] as $cell) {
                        $area[$cell] = true;
                        if ($blank[$cell] && !$seen[$cell]) {
                            $seen[$cell] = true;
                            $queue[] = $cell;
                        }
                    };
                }
                $largest = max($largest, count($area));
            }
            if (
                !$this->mines[$start] &&
                !$blank[$start] &&
                !array_filter($this->neighbors[$start], fn(int $cell): bool => $blank[$cell])
            ) {
                $isolated++;
            }
        }
        emit(
            "3bv",
            $openings + $isolated,
            "openings",
            $openings,
            "largest",
            $largest,
            "mines",
            $this->mineCount,
            "safe",
            $this->size - $this->mineCount,
        );
    }
}

final class Program
{
    private const ARITY = [
        "NEW" => 4,
        "PRESET" => 2,
        "SAFETY" => 1,
        "RESTART" => 0,
        "REVEAL" => 2,
        "FLAG" => 2,
        "UNFLAG" => 2,
        "QUESTION" => 2,
        "CHORD" => 2,
        "UNDO" => 0,
        "SHOW" => 0,
        "STATUS" => 0,
        "CELL" => 2,
        "HISTORY" => 1,
        "REPLAY" => 1,
        "HINT" => 0,
        "AUTO" => 0,
        "ANALYZE" => 0,
        "PROB" => 2,
        "FRONTIER" => 0,
        "SOLVE" => 0,
        "BOARDINFO" => 0,
        "STATS" => 0,
    ];
    private ?Game $game = null;
    private Safety $safety = Safety::Block;
    private int $played = 0,
        $won = 0,
        $lost = 0,
        $streak = 0,
        $bestStreak = 0;
    private ?int $fastest = null;

    private function layout(array $words): void
    {
        $width = (int) $words[1];
        $height = (int) $words[2];
        $rows = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $height; $i++) {
            $rows[] = inputLine();
        }
        $mines = [];
        foreach ($rows as $i => $row) {
            if (strlen($row) !== $width || strspn($row, ".*") !== $width) {
                fail("bad row " . ($i + 1));
            }
            for ($x = 0; $x < $width; $x++) {
                $mines[] = $row[$x] === "*";
            }
        }
        $count = count(array_filter($mines));
        if ($count === 0 || $count === $width * $height) {
            fail("bad mine count $count");
        }
        $this->game = new Game($width, $height, $count, 1, $mines);
        emit("layout", "{$width}x{$height}", "mines", $count);
    }
    private function number(string $word): int
    {
        if (!preg_match("/\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,9})\z/", $word)) {
            fail("bad arguments");
        }
        return (int) $word;
    }
    private function stats(): void
    {
        $rate = $this->played === 0 ? "-" : intdiv($this->won * 100, $this->played) . "%";
        emit(
            "stats played",
            $this->played,
            "won",
            $this->won,
            "lost",
            $this->lost,
            "rate",
            $rate,
            "streak",
            $this->streak,
            "best",
            $this->bestStreak,
            "fastest",
            $this->fastest ?? "-",
        );
    }
    private function recordFinish(Game $game): void
    {
        $this->played++;
        if ($game->state === GameState::Won) {
            $this->won++;
            $this->streak++;
            $this->bestStreak = max($this->bestStreak, $this->streak);
            $this->fastest = min($this->fastest ?? count($game->moves), count($game->moves));
        } else {
            $this->lost++;
            $this->streak = 0;
        }
    }
    public function execute(array $words): void
    {
        $op = $words[0];
        if ($op === "LAYOUT") {
            $this->layout($words);
            return;
        }
        if (!isset(self::ARITY[$op])) {
            fail("unknown command $op");
        }
        if (count($words) !== self::ARITY[$op] + 1) {
            fail("bad arguments");
        }
        $hasCell = in_array(
            $op,
            ["REVEAL", "FLAG", "UNFLAG", "QUESTION", "CHORD", "CELL", "PROB"],
            true,
        );
        $values = [];
        if ($op === "NEW" || $hasCell || $op === "HISTORY" || $op === "REPLAY") {
            $values = array_map($this->number(...), array_slice($words, 1));
        } elseif ($op === "PRESET") {
            if (!in_array($words[1], ["beginner", "intermediate", "expert"], true)) {
                fail("bad arguments");
            }
            $values = [$this->number($words[2])];
        } elseif ($op === "SAFETY" && Safety::tryFrom($words[1]) === null) {
            fail("bad arguments");
        }

        if ($op === "NEW" || $op === "PRESET") {
            if ($op === "NEW") {
                [$width, $height, $mines, $seed] = $values;
            } else {
                [$width, $height, $mines] = match ($words[1]) {
                    "beginner" => [9, 9, 10],
                    "intermediate" => [16, 16, 40],
                    "expert" => [30, 16, 99],
                };
                $seed = $values[0];
            }
            if (
                $width < 1 ||
                $width > 30 ||
                $height < 1 ||
                $height > 30 ||
                $mines < 1 ||
                $mines > $width * $height - 9 ||
                $seed < 1 ||
                $seed > 2147483646
            ) {
                fail("bad value");
            }
            $this->game = new Game($width, $height, $mines, $seed);
            emit("new", "{$width}x{$height}", "mines", $mines);
            return;
        }
        if ($op === "HISTORY" && $values[0] === 0) {
            fail("bad value");
        }
        if ($op === "SAFETY") {
            $this->safety = Safety::from($words[1]);
            emit("safety", $words[1]);
            return;
        }
        if ($op === "STATS") {
            $this->stats();
            return;
        }
        $game = $this->game ?? fail("no game");
        if ($hasCell && ($values[0] >= $game->width || $values[1] >= $game->height)) {
            fail("out of range");
        }
        $cell = $hasCell ? $values[1] * $game->width + $values[0] : 0;
        if (
            $game->finished() &&
            in_array(
                $op,
                [
                    "REVEAL",
                    "FLAG",
                    "UNFLAG",
                    "QUESTION",
                    "CHORD",
                    "UNDO",
                    "HINT",
                    "AUTO",
                    "ANALYZE",
                    "PROB",
                    "FRONTIER",
                    "SOLVE",
                ],
                true,
            )
        ) {
            fail("game over");
        }
        if (($op === "ANALYZE" || $op === "BOARDINFO") && $game->mines === null) {
            fail("not started");
        }
        $wasFinished = $game->finished();
        $saved = in_array(
            $op,
            ["REVEAL", "FLAG", "UNFLAG", "QUESTION", "CHORD", "AUTO", "SOLVE"],
            true,
        )
            ? $game->snapshot(strtolower($op))
            : null;

        switch ($op) {
            case "RESTART":
                $game->restart();
                emit("restart", "{$game->width}x{$game->height}", "mines", $game->mineCount);
                break;
            case "REVEAL":
                if ($game->revealed[$cell]) {
                    fail("already revealed");
                }
                if ($game->marks[$cell] === Mark::Flag) {
                    fail("flagged");
                }
                $game->moves[] = new Move(MoveKind::Reveal, $cell);
                $opened = $game->reveal($cell, $this->safety);
                if ($game->state !== GameState::Lost) {
                    emit("revealed", $opened);
                    $game->checkWin();
                }
                $game->ending();
                break;
            case "FLAG":
            case "UNFLAG":
            case "QUESTION":
                if ($game->revealed[$cell]) {
                    fail("already revealed");
                }
                if ($op === "FLAG" && $game->marks[$cell] === Mark::Flag) {
                    fail("already flagged");
                }
                if ($op === "UNFLAG" && $game->marks[$cell] !== Mark::Flag) {
                    fail("not flagged");
                }
                if ($op === "FLAG") {
                    $mark = Mark::Flag;
                    $kind = MoveKind::Flag;
                    $verb = "flagged";
                } elseif ($op === "UNFLAG") {
                    $mark = Mark::None;
                    $kind = MoveKind::Unflag;
                    $verb = "unflagged";
                } else {
                    $mark = $game->marks[$cell] === Mark::Question ? Mark::None : Mark::Question;
                    $kind = MoveKind::Question;
                    $verb = $mark === Mark::None ? "unmarked" : "questioned";
                }
                $game->marks[$cell] = $mark;
                $game->moves[] = new Move($kind, $cell);
                emit($verb, $game->cell($cell), "left", $game->remaining());
                break;
            case "CHORD":
                if (!$game->revealed[$cell]) {
                    fail("not revealed");
                }
                if ($game->numbers[$cell] === 0) {
                    fail("no number");
                }
                $flags = $game->flags($cell);
                if ($flags !== $game->numbers[$cell]) {
                    fail("flags $flags of {$game->numbers[$cell]}");
                }
                if ($game->unknownNeighbors($cell) === []) {
                    fail("nothing to reveal");
                }
                $game->moves[] = new Move(MoveKind::Chord, $cell);
                $opened = $game->chord($cell, $this->safety);
                if ($game->state !== GameState::Lost) {
                    emit("chorded", $opened);
                    $game->checkWin();
                }
                $game->ending();
                break;
            case "UNDO":
                if ($game->undo === []) {
                    fail("nothing to undo");
                }
                $record = array_pop($game->undo);
                $game->restore($record);
                emit("undo", $record->name, "moves", count($game->moves));
                break;
            case "SHOW":
                $game->display();
                break;
            case "STATUS":
                emit(
                    "status",
                    $game->state->value,
                    "left",
                    $game->remaining(),
                    "moves",
                    count($game->moves),
                    "revealed",
                    $game->openCount() . "/" . ($game->size - $game->mineCount),
                );
                break;
            case "CELL":
                if ($game->revealed[$cell]) {
                    emit(
                        "cell",
                        $game->cell($cell),
                        "number",
                        $game->numbers[$cell],
                        "flags",
                        $game->flags($cell),
                        "unknown",
                        count($game->unknownNeighbors($cell)),
                    );
                } else {
                    emit(
                        "cell",
                        $game->cell($cell),
                        "hidden mark",
                        $game->marks[$cell]->value,
                        "open",
                        count(
                            array_filter(
                                $game->neighbors[$cell],
                                fn(int $other): bool => $game->revealed[$other],
                            ),
                        ),
                    );
                }
                break;
            case "HISTORY":
                $count = count($game->moves);
                emit("history", $count);
                for ($i = max(0, $count - $values[0]); $i < $count; $i++) {
                    $move = $game->moves[$i];
                    emit($i + 1, $move->kind->value, $game->cell($move->cell));
                }
                break;
            case "REPLAY":
                if ($values[0] > count($game->moves)) {
                    fail("no move {$values[0]}");
                }
                emit("replay", $values[0] . "/" . count($game->moves));
                $game->replay($values[0], $this->safety)->display();
                break;
            case "HINT":
                $deduction = $game->deduce();
                $found = false;
                foreach (
                    ["safe" => $deduction->safe, "mine" => $deduction->mines]
                    as $kind => $reasons
                ) {
                    foreach ($reasons as $at => $reason) {
                        if ($reason !== null) {
                            emit("hint", $kind, $game->cell($at), "by", $reason);
                            $found = true;
                            break 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!$found) {
                    emit("hint none");
                }
                break;
            case "AUTO":
            case "SOLVE":
                $total = $op === "AUTO" ? $game->auto($this->safety) : $game->solve($this->safety);
                if ($op === "AUTO") {
                    emit(
                        "auto rounds",
                        $total->rounds,
                        "flagged",
                        $total->flagged,
                        "revealed",
                        $total->opened,
                    );
                } else {
                    emit(
                        "solve guesses",
                        $total->guesses,
                        "rounds",
                        $total->rounds,
                        "flagged",
                        $total->flagged,
                        "revealed",
                        $total->opened,
                    );
                }
                $game->ending();
                break;
            case "ANALYZE":
                $copy = $game->copy();
                $total = $copy->auto($this->safety);
                if ($copy->state === GameState::Lost) {
                    emit("analyze boom", $copy->cell($copy->exploded), "rounds", $total->rounds);
                } elseif ($copy->state === GameState::Won) {
                    emit("analyze clear rounds", $total->rounds);
                } else {
                    emit(
                        "analyze stuck rounds",
                        $total->rounds,
                        "revealed",
                        $copy->openCount() . "/" . ($copy->size - $copy->mineCount),
                    );
                }
                break;
            case "PROB":
                if ($game->revealed[$cell]) {
                    fail("already revealed");
                }
                if ($game->marks[$cell] === Mark::Flag) {
                    fail("flagged");
                }
                $component = $game->frontier()->at[$cell];
                if ($component === null) {
                    emit("prob", $game->cell($cell), "unconstrained");
                } else {
                    $component->count();
                    if ($component->configurations === 0) {
                        emit("prob", $game->cell($cell), "inconsistent");
                    } else {
                        emit(
                            "prob",
                            $game->cell($cell),
                            fraction($component->mineCount($cell), $component->configurations),
                            "size",
                            count($component->cells),
                            "configs",
                            $component->configurations,
                        );
                    }
                }
                break;
            case "FRONTIER":
                $frontier = $game->frontier();
                emit(
                    "frontier",
                    count(array_filter($frontier->at)),
                    "components",
                    count($frontier->components),
                );
                foreach ($frontier->components as $component) {
                    $component->count();
                    $at = $game->cell($component->cells[0]);
                    $size = count($component->cells);
                    if ($component->configurations === 0) {
                        emit("component", $at, "size", $size, "inconsistent");
                    } else {
                        emit(
                            "component",
                            $at,
                            "size",
                            $size,
                            "configs",
                            $component->configurations,
                            "min",
                            $component->minimum,
                            "max",
                            $component->maximum,
                        );
                    }
                }
                break;
            case "BOARDINFO":
                $game->boardInfo();
                break;
        }
        if ($saved !== null && count($game->moves) > $saved->moveCount) {
            $game->undo[] = $saved;
        }
        if (!$wasFinished && $game->finished()) {
            $this->recordFinish($game);
        }
    }
}

$program = new Program();
$commandCount = (int) inputLine();
for ($command = 0; $command < $commandCount; $command++) {
    try {
        $program->execute(explode(" ", inputLine()));
    } catch (CommandError $error) {
        emit("error:", $error->getMessage());
    }
}
